data: same 695 people / 1064 front124 windows, cached frozen MotionBERT 512 features and matched 17-joint xy/confidence
outer: same five person folds: train556 held139
inner: reuse saved four internal folds: train417 validation139
reconstruct: M is unchanged original joint-PLS selected-model mean; predicted L=M+D/2, R=M-D/2
selection: within each family minimize pooled inner person-macro signed-gap MAE; fixed candidate order breaks ties. Guarded method includes original joint PLS and all gap candidates: admit only inner overall MAE no greater than original joint PLS, then minimize gap MAE; no held-person results used
mean_reference: use saved original inner PLS predictions for the outer-selected component count (32 in all existing folds); selected using outer training people only. The candidate expansion and study choice followed prior development results, so no independent final-validation claim
training: record equal; StandardScaler fit on each training slice only; single-target PLS scale=False,max_iter=500,tol=1e-6; Ridge intercept fitted
leg_features: Per side: root-relative hip/knee/ankle xy, image-plane knee flexion, thigh length and shank length. Each signal summarized by 10/25/50/75/90 percentiles and population SD. Concatenate left, right, left-minus-right summaries and two knee-valid-frame fractions = 164 features. Confidence-positive lower joints only; zero-length knee angles omitted, no interpolation or relabeling.
checks: training and held-person gap/overall MAE, signed-gap correlation, predicted gap magnitude, direction accuracy excluding true zero gaps, overall bins and tail bias; constants are controls not clinical assumptions

bootstrap.interpretation: exploratory paired conditional OOF interval, selection uncertainty excluded
